title: Aspire: orchestration, DevEx and observability with built-in AI
summary: 45-minute talk on .NET Aspire as the glue for distributed architectures, covering multi-agent AI systems, polyglot services, full OpenTelemetry observability and deployment to Kubernetes/AKS. My most attended talk to date, with a full room.

title: DevOps & Cloud Course (1st edition), co-organizer and speaker
summary: Four weekly sessions on Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure, GitHub Actions and platform engineering, with industry guest speakers; final session open to the public with GitHub Community España.

title: Workshop: taking a C# Minimal API to production with GitHub Actions and Azure
venue: Hackers Week, ETSI Informática, University of Málaga (with Alejandro Cerezo Contreras)
summary: Hands-on CI/CD workshop closing the gap between code that runs locally and professionally deployed software. Full classroom.

title: Data Science with F#
venue: dotnetMÁLAGA community meetup, hosted at Verisk, Málaga
summary: My first technical community talk. How F#'s strong typing and functional pipelines make data analysis safer and faster than typical Python workflows, with examples from iGEM UMA biological data analysis.
